verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a tax calculation API (POST `/tax/calculations`) that takes an address and products and returns the tax to charge, and its integrations calculate tax at checkout time, so the core real-time API calculation is evidenced. The pack never claims rooftop or address-level geocoding accuracy, and the new IP-based resolution option points toward coarser lookups, not finer ones. No latency figures or SLA support the claim that it is fast enough to sit inside checkout. Missing for 10: evidence of rooftop/address-level jurisdiction accuracy (vs ZIP), documented latency/performance suited to checkout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
